description: The dashboards of a project's monitoring (get_monitoring) — by words of their titles — each with its uid, folder, tags and link; or, with 'dashboard' (a uid), that dashboard's panels with the PromQL behind each, which is what monitoring_query is best asked with. For the people who work in the project and the company; at most 60 reads of a project's monitoring an hour, agents and people together. A refusal has a 'state': not_connected (with the 'url' of the screen that connects one), off, refused, sealed, unreachable, busy, too_big, missing, no_access, not_found, bad_request.

dashboard.description: One dashboard's uid, for its panels and their queries.

name: monitoring_dashboards
title: Monitoring dashboards
